The driver raised the route change first at 17:20 [F8], so this is a route agreed in advance, not a detour announced afterwards [RD-5].

The exception RD-5 carves out of a general authorisation is an errand of the driver's own — a stop away from the route or a loop that reaches nothing. The fare's distance and time components [F7] are the meter's own, not an unpublished add-on, so FARE-1 adds nothing. RD-6's precondition is not met — route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0 [F18] — so no account flag is warranted [RD-6].
